# RepoRelay

> RepoRelay is an open-source local MCP bridge that gives ChatGPT bounded access to one explicitly approved local repository for inspection and search, without exposing shell, Git execution, machine-wide filesystem access, or arbitrary source-file writes.

This is a concise machine-readable project map, not an official search-engine standard and not a guarantee of ranking, citation, or inclusion.

## Canonical identity

- Project: RepoRelay by Lukie-81
- Official website: https://lukie-81.github.io/RepoRelay/
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/Lukie-81/RepoRelay
- npm package: `reporelay-mcp` at https://www.npmjs.com/package/reporelay-mcp
- MCP server identifier: `io.github.Lukie-81/reporelay`
- RepoRelay is local/self-hosted software. It is not ChatGPT, OpenAI, Codex, GitHub, or the OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel.

## Terminology

- ChatGPT Web is the MCP client/reviewer.
- MCP is the tool-calling protocol.
- OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel is the external connectivity layer.
- `tunnel-client` is the local tunnel forwarder.
- RepoRelay is the local MCP server and application security boundary.
- The approved repository is the one local directory in scope.

## Important limits

The normal CLI quickstart exposes four inspection tools and three fixed handoff writers. `--no-handoff-writes` exposes only the four inspection tools. RepoRelay is not an operating-system sandbox and does not claim to discover every secret in an arbitrary repository. Check the current repository source and `SECURITY.md` before relying on a claim.
